reviews.review:
Great game also its free! If you are wondering if you should try it out. If you enjoy fast fps games and don't mind farming.
Replayability-If you take a few weeks or months off then comeback. Most likely there will be at least one big patch that may change your playstyle, so always make sure to skim through the news after coming back. Now welcome back, 10 prime weapons and frames were vaulted. but don't worry! we made 20 more new ones! now go farm for them! Honestly? The Replayability of the game is okay. It just may take a hour to get back into the groove of things

Pros
-Free
-A variety of weapons and frames which is always being added to 
-Great graphics
-Can run on even a laptop
-Helpful community
-Very active developers, streaming the new patches and weapons
-A load of worlds to explore and re-play.. over... and over.. and over.. and over.. and over.. and over.. and over.. and over.. and over again.
 
Cons
-Platinum is expensive
-Actually  buying items with platinum is expensive
-Grinding---Grinding for frames- Going through a boss run over and over to get 4 different parts and you can always get a helmet 5x in a row.(also you can't trade frames/blueprint) 
-12 hours to make forma? 72 hours to make a whole frame?
-Loading in public matches (or even offline) can take forever 
-Ping spikes

Now if you have decided to get the game, you may want to read the rest of this-

Grinding for prime frames and or prime weapons- At first you would be able to run a void mission and get some prime blueprints. Now you need to farm relics, and if you are looking for a specific prime blueprint, the blueprint may not even be in the relic. If you really want specific blueprints, I reccomend playing with friends since everybody votes for what you get in the relics. When voting one blueprint from your relic can only be picked decreasing your chances of getting a specific blueprint.

Having friends to play the game is almost mandatory

I really really ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ loved this game on ps4 and the only reason i refuse to play it is because i cant transfer my account from ps4 on to pc that ive spent 2 entire years grinding on i am so passionate about this game and really irritated that i cant transfer my account over.

UPDATE:
I found out you can now transfer your old account. I now have around 200ish hours on PC alone.

Yeah I know, "2000 hours does not recommend" funny. I absolutely loved this game, but at this point bad development practices and worse community relations soured everything I used to enjoy.

[list]
[*] Game leans heavily on shiny new content keeping vets' attention and attracting new players, meaning older content gets left half finished and full of bugs, never to see balance adjustments, bug fixes, or new content.
[*] Constant power creep. New content is made to be more powerful and more exciting than old to keep people interested (and spending). Older content is essentially meaningless clutter that you use once and throw away.
[*] Devs have been becoming more aloof and self-superior, ignoring player feedback or outright refusing it because "me big brain developer and you dum-dum player"
[*] Over-emphasis on meta pandering. If you want to be effective at any recent or "end game" content, have fun looking up builds. This game is at its most fun when you're mauling your way through dozens of enemies at a time, but most of the end game content puts an excessive emphasis on tough, high damage enemies where your only options are to abuse stuns and status effect stacking to try and kill them before they one-hit you.
[*] In game community is a mess. Do not use region chat, most mods were chosen through nepotism and can do no wrong, bans are impossible to appeal, and if you get unlucky and trade with someone who bought their currency with a stolen card, you get account banned with no recourse.
[/list]

I don't really have a conclusion. You're probably interested in this game because you saw some gameplay from like 6 years ago when this game was vastly different. I'm not saying it's not fun, but as someone who's been there to see the changes, it's just not the game I used to love.
NIce gameplay, good gun mechanics and enjoyable grind
Started playing 5 years ago. Still keep coming back to it on pc, ps4 & Xbox. I love seeing how far they've come. This is a true game that is made by people who truly love what they make.
